adjudications.reason: The N3485 oracle selects the fixed-arity partial. Clang changed only in 20 after its P3310/CWG2398 rewrite and selects the variadic partial when template-template and nested template-id packs occur together; each dimension alone still selects fixed. Clang 19, Clang 20 with relaxed template-template matching disabled, Apple Clang 17, GCC 15, CPPGM, and the runtime/LowIR contract all select fixed.

policy: During patched-Clang reference generation, require the pinned source and raw rendered witness hashes, apply the declared exact rewrite, verify the adjudicated hash, and write that adjudicated text as the adjacent .ref.witness. Comparison remains an ordinary literal reference comparison.
